card.title: The space between words becomes a visible break

motion.summary: GREAT DEEP arches above BROKE OPEN; the two lower words separate to create a widening central gap while the following lyric builds underneath.
phases: Begin with a restrained word and fault-like background marks.
Assemble the primary phrase with a shaped upper line.

motion.transferablePrinciple: Make the relationship between words perform the verb, while the letters remain readable.

cautions: A gap must remain legible as intentional separation rather than poor spacing.
Use new shapes or materials; repeated thin fault lines would become generic texture.
Keep later lines clear of the separated words and scene boundaries.
